input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: The grant is perpetual and not revocable at will (Section 17(a) keeps the licence in effect perpetually while fees are paid, with termination only on insolvency or uncured 30-day default), so the term aspect is compliant. However, the licence covers only affiliated companies "operating at Authorized Locations" and says nothing about contractors or outsourced service providers acting on our behalf, and it is expressly "non-transferable", reinforced by Section 3(c) and Section 20(d) which bar assignment without Garman's consent — leaving no successor-transfer path in an M&A transaction. We therefore added affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, a successor-transfer right, and conforming carve-outs in Sections 3(c) and 20(d).

proposal.summary: Extend the licence to Sparkling's affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf and permit transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the licence to our affiliated companies and to contractors and outsourced service providers using the Software on our behalf, and added a successor-transfer right, with conforming changes to Sections 3(c) and 20(d). Our playbook requires operational use by affiliates and contractors and continuity of the licence through a merger or sale of the business; the perpetual term in Section 17(a) is acceptable as drafted.

ops.oldText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use
ops.newText: for the use of Sparkling, affiliated companies of Sparkling and contractors and outsourced service providers acting on Sparkling's behalf, a non-exclusive licence, transferable to a successor to all or substantially all of Sparkling's business or assets, to use

ops.oldText: except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;
ops.newText: except (i) to affiliated companies of Sparkling and contractors and outsourced service providers acting on Sparkling's behalf as contemplated by Section 2, (ii) to a successor to all or substantially all of Sparkling's business or assets, or (iii) as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;

ops.oldText: without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: without the written consent of the other party, except that either party may assign this Agreement, without such consent, to a successor to all or substantially all of its business or assets by merger, reorganization or sale.
